items.source: Implementations of this interface can be configured on a SubProtocolWebSocketHandler which selects a sub-protocol handler to delegate messages to based on the sub-protocol requested by the client through the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol request header.
items.translation: 该接口的实现可以在SubProtocolWebSocketHandler中进行配置，该处理器会根据客户端通过Sec-WebSocket-Protocol请求头请求的子协议，选择用于委托消息处理的子协议处理器。

items.source: Invoked after a WebSocketSession has ended.
items.translation: 在 `WebSocketSession` 结束后被调用。

items.source: Invoked after a WebSocketSession has started.
items.translation: 在 `WebSocketSession` 启动后调用。

items.source: Handle the given WebSocketMessage received from a client.
items.translation: 处理从客户端接收的WebSocketMessage。

items.source: Handle the given Message to the client associated with the given WebSocket session.
items.translation: 将给定的Message处理到与给定 WebSocket 会话关联的客户端。

items.source: Return the list of sub-protocols supported by this handler (never null).
items.translation: 返回此处理器支持的子协议列表（永远不为null）。

items.source: Resolve the session id from the given message or return null.
items.translation: 从给定的消息中解析会话 ID，或返回null。

items.source: outputChannel - an output channel to send messages to
items.translation: outputChannel - 用于发送消息的输出通道

items.source: message - the message to resolve the session id from
items.translation: message - 用于解析会话 ID 的消息

items.source: closeStatus - the reason why the session was closed
